column2: To qualify for the TLS, you must have: Booked a flat and received an invitation to collect the keys Applied to sell your existing flat Fully redeemed your housing loan of your existing flat, if the loan is provided by a financial institution (FI) You must be: Able to pay the full purchase price of the flat using the following: CPF Ordinary Account balance CPF refund and cash proceeds from the sale of your existing flat If the funds are not sufficient for your flat purchase, you must be able to top up the shortfall by the date given by HDB, before HDB may consider your request for the TLS.
Please submit your request for the TLS when you apply to sell your existing flat.
